$comment: Designwright shared design-token template. Copy into a project as the starting point for its own token record (e.g. .design/tokens.json), then adapt roles to the project's identity. Central guidance supplies method; the project supplies identity.

meta.usage: Copy, rename, and adapt. Never import this file verbatim into a product — project tokens must be chosen from project evidence.

radius.rule: Exactly three radii. Sharp (0) only for data-dense tables by explicit decision.

spacing.rule: One spacing rhythm per surface. Gaps inside a component use the lower half of the scale; gaps between sections use the upper half.

status.rule: Status is dot + text badge, never color alone. success/warning/danger/info map to the color roles above in both themes.

data.note: Figures, identifiers, timestamps. Always tabular numerals.

display.note: Page titles, hero numbers. Exactly one display size per screen.

type.rule: Three roles only. No fourth typeface without a direction-level decision.
